log_level.description: Minimum logging level. Choices: debug, info, warning, error.

syslog_enabled.description: Whether to log to local syslog.

packet_capture_enabled.description: Enable native packet capture (requires elevated privileges). Note: This template parametrizes 'netflow' and 'sflow' booleans, and the interface for capture. The 'packet_capture_enabled' schema item is a logical grouping; in this config, the specific capture methods (netflow, sflow) are controlled by netflow_enabled and sflow_enabled. The 'interfaces' line controls the capture interface.

packet_capture_interface.description: Network interface to monitor for packets (e.g., eth0).

sflow_enabled.description: Enable sFlow collector (use if your network devices send sFlow).

sflow_port.description: UDP port to listen for sFlow packets.

netflow_port.description: UDP/TCP port to listen for NetFlow traffic.

bandwidth_threshold_mbps.description: Bandwidth threshold (Mbps) above which mitigation triggers.

flows_threshold_fps.description: Flows-per-second threshold triggering mitigation. Note: The schema default was 5000, but the real file default is 3500. Using real file default for sample_values accuracy, but schema can be adjusted if 5000 is preferred as a 'recommended' default.

api_enabled.description: Enable REST API for programmatic access and integration. Note: The real file has 'enable_api = on' (gRPC API). The schema refers to REST API. We map 'api_enabled' to 'enable_api' as it's the only API toggle.

api_address.description: IP address for API binding (also used for Prometheus host).
